cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. For example, */5 * * * * runs every 5 minutes.
deleteScheduleHint: Deleting “{{name}}” stops scheduling and preserves run history. A running schedule cannot be deleted.
description: Service availability, task queues and request metrics for the last 5 minutes.
executorDescription: Platform import and export tasks run in a separate executor within the API process.
healthCheckHint: Check the API, database, cache, storage, and background execution. No additional parameters are required.
requestActive: The API is serving this request.
runAuthorizationUnavailable: Authorization could not be checked. The run was rejected.
runForbidden: The execution identity no longer has the required permissions.
scheduleEditorHint: Set the frequency and time zone. Disabling stops automatic triggers; manual runs remain available.
schedulePermissionHint: Creating and editing this task also requires permission to read runtime monitoring.
scheduleResultHint: Completed means a monitoring snapshot was collected. Check each probe for the actual service status.
scheduleRunSubmitted: A manual run of “{{name}}” was submitted. View the result in run history.
schedulesDescription: Run by Cron and time zone. Each schedule runs without overlap; missed runs during downtime are skipped.
signal-no-data: There are no usable samples in this window.
signal-ready: A runtime signal was received within 90 seconds.
signal-stale: No runtime signal for over 90 seconds. Check the worker.
signal-unavailable: The monitoring source could not be read.
signal-unconfigured: No monitoring source configured; current status is unknown.
storageDisabled: File storage is disabled in this deployment.
timeZoneHint: Use an IANA time zone, such as Asia/Shanghai or UTC.
title: Runtime monitor
